result:
QA-21915 ran on dev and the verdict is **FAIL**. The UCLA row passes, but the Gatorade row has native likes about 13% below LFM Reactions.

The Tuesday row of the case names two account/brand pairs, so I ran both. The first post on Instagram only (Nov 9–15 default week) gave:

| Row | LFM Reactions | Native likes | Variation | Comments |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| UCLA / University of California, Los Angeles | 3,934 | 4,014 | +2.0% | 10 vs 10 |
| Wasserman / Gatorade | 10,015 | 8,672 | −13.4% | 52 vs 50 |

- **Threshold:** the spec gives no number for "big variations". I used about 10% as the bound, matching earlier observations on this flow. A reviewer who sets the bar above 13% would pass the Gatorade row.
- **Native read:** I re-read the Gatorade native post twice in a fresh tab and got 8,672 each time, so the shortfall is stable.
- **Known bug:** native lower than LFM is the pattern of open bug LFMP-32113. That bug is linked to sibling case QA-21913, not to this one. The 2026-10-22 run of QA-21915 failed the same way (−41%).
- **Screening:** the case file lists no open linked bugs and today's open-bug map has no entry for it, so the case ran normally.
- **Cleanup:** nothing was created or saved. The Playwright sandbox couldn't read files, so I passed the dev credentials from `config/.env` into the login call myself.

I did no skill or REGISTRY maintenance and filed no bugs, per the run rules.

The report is at `results/2026-11-17/QA-21915-report.md`, with screenshots under `.playwright-out/QA-21915/`.
